messages:
zara: Heads-up: SA-1 warm-pool is spinning up and immediately failing bootstrap since ~07:12 UTC. Lots of GPU churn and high retry rates.

liam: any service errors or agent logs?

zara: node-agent shows KMS/keystore decrypt failures and TLS to audit collector getting reset: 
```
[2026-08-04T07:13:05Z] keystore: Decrypt failed: KMS.AccessDenied: condition 'resource.tags.environment == \"prod\"' not satisfied
[2026-08-04T07:13:05Z] bootstrap: attestation aborted
[2026-08-04T07:13:06Z] audit-exporter: POST https://audit-collector.internal/v1/ingest -> connection reset by peer
```

sec-bot: Alert: 58 nodes failing bootstrap in south-america-1 (>4m). Incident created: INFRA-9907.

tess: Quick read: security applied a KMS key-policy change last night to restrict decrypt to resources with tag environment=prod and tightened the collector SG to drop suspicious handshakes. Also audit sampling was lowered to 10% at 01:00 to cut exporter egress costs. Looks like three simultaneous drifts.

liam: So nodes launched in the warm-pool are missing the environment tag on their subnet/NIC so KMS denies, and audit-exporter pattern looks like it matched the SG drop rule. That would cause attestation timeouts and retries.

zara: Cost note from billing-bot: current churn projected to burn an extra ~700 GPU-min in next hour if not mitigated (~$1k).

liam: Immediate playbook: 1) pause warm-pool autoscaling to stop new launches 2) temporarily relax KMS policy to allow infra-node-role decrypts for the SA account 3) add SG exception for node-agent TLS/cert CN to audit-collector 4) batch-restart stuck nodes after approvals. Who can do 2 & 3?

tess: I can push the SG exception. Liam, can you handle the KMS temporary policy patch and coordinate with security for proper PR? I'll also pause autoscaling.

zara: Pausing autoscaling now: ``aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name sa-warm-pool --max-size 80 --min-size 20 --region south-america-1``

liam: Applying temp KMS policy to re-add infra-node-role principal (will log and revert after). Command: ``aws kms put-key-policy --key-id 1234-aaaa --policy file://temp-allow-infra.json --region south-america-1``. Filing formal PR for scoped exception.

tess: SG exception in place: allowed tag:Service=node-agent -> audit-collector:443. Flow logs now show ACCEPT for agent->collector flows that were previously REJECT.

sec-bot: INFRA-9907 updated with mitigations and owners.

zara: Restarting 12 stuck agents in small batches to clear backoff. Watching logs.

liam: After KMS patch and SG exception we see decrypts succeeding and attestations progressing. ~70% of stuck nodes finished join after two batches. Remaining ones had certificate timeouts; requeued and restarting.

finance-bot: Cost update: projection down to ~180 GPU-min extra (~$260) after mitigation.

tess: Post-incident quick actions: 1) update onboarding to ensure subnet/NIC has environment tag 2) change SG rule to match stricter fingerprint of malformed handshakes so node-agent isn't matched 3) add presubmit tests simulating node bootstrap under sampling toggles. I'll own 2 & 3.

liam: I'll own the KMS policy PR and add an automated check in the policy CI that validates principals used by infra roles. Also adding a metric: keystore.decrypt.accept_rate (30s window) with an alert if it drops >0.5%.

zara: Agreed. Also update runbook to include a step: if audit sampling or SG rules change, coordinate a warm-pool canary first. Ticket INFRA-9907 assigned and left open for RCA. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
